## Step

1. Navigate to Loyalty App > Membership Card > Membership Card List.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="346" height="197" style="width: 346px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Click to view membership card details.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="662" height="272" style="width: 662px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3.

- Modify existing card image, title and description, 

* Delete or copy membership card.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="498" height="344" style="width: 498px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
